label: input r mid-sequence (t=4-6) in sequences starting with b and containing 0/y/i/x
explanation: Very sparse conjunctive feature. Almost all activations are in the original phase at t=4-6 (about 98% of mass); 75% of mass is on input token r, and 90% of mass is in sequences whose first token is b. Earlier tokens 0, y, i, x raise the rate (prev_tok y/0 about 8-10x lift). The strongest examples are b 0 y y r and b x 0 y r. Activations are larger when more of 0/y/i/x come before the r (requiring at least 2 of them gives dev precision 0.58 but recall 0.22). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<3, and only weakly on <DEL> in b-initial sequences. Some activations occur without r or without a leading b (e.g. i i 0 i r). Dev F1 is about 0.34, mass recall 0.60: there is a clear core of r after b...0/y context, but the exact hidden-state condition is not fully captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 39 cues. Raise it: orig0=b (+5.38), orig1=i (+2.76), prev_tok=y (+2.35), prev_tok=0 (+2.20), prev2_tok=0 (+2.10), orig1=b (+1.75). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-1.78), phase=2 (-1.67), orig_idx=-1 (-1.58), prev3_tok=b (-1.40).
